description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Video' that renders an SVG icon representing a video symbol. It uses Emotion CSS-in-JS for styling and imports utility components and types from a local 'util' module.

methods.name: Video
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a 'Video' SVG icon, accepting props defined by 'IconProps'. It conditionally applies a gradient fill based on the 'grad' prop.
